method: Get each indexed file's Drive parent IDs, follow the unique parent chain until no parent remains or registered root is reached; no file bytes downloaded.
verified_additional_facts: Each of the six source file IDs exists and resolves by Drive metadata.
Each source ID appears in its actual direct parent's Drive folder listing.
No ancestry chain reaches the source registry's recorded project root folder before Drive reports no further parent.
Project/source association and ownership must be reviewed independently; absence of ancestry alone does not prove the original file was assigned to the wrong project.
prohibited_automatic_actions: Do not move, rename or duplicate any source file
Do not modify the six existing published source URLs or canonical resource IDs
Do not substitute an arbitrary parent as the new project root
Do not publish additional private ancestor folder names/IDs in GitHub
resolution: Owner-authorized project source root mapping with original Drive pointers preserved, explicit reviewed alternative root IDs privately, FK verification, safe readback and archive.
